question: U Srinivas is associated with which musical instrument?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Mandolin**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] __Key Points__

__
 
• U Srinivas was a renowned Indian mandolin player in the Carnatic classical music tradition.
 
• He is widely recognized for bringing the mandolin to the forefront of Indian classical music.
 
• He started learning music at a very young age and gave his first public performance at the age of 9.
 
• U Srinivas received numerous awards including the Padma Shri and Sangeet Natak Akademi Award for his contributions to music.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Mandolin:**

 
 
• The mandolin is a stringed musical instrument in the lute family and is usually plucked with a plectrum or pick.
 
• It commonly has four courses of doubled metal strings tuned in unison, although there are many variations.
 
• Mandolins are used in a variety of musical genres including classical, folk, bluegrass, and rock.
 
• In Indian classical music, particularly Carnatic music, the mandolin has been adapted and popularized by musicians like U Srinivas.
 
 
 
• **Carnatic Music:**
 
 
• Carnatic music is a system of music commonly associated with southern India, and it is one of the two main subgenres of Indian classical music.
 
• It emphasizes a highly structured rhythmic and melodic framework and is known for its complex compositions and improvisational aspects.
 
• Instruments commonly used in Carnatic music include the veena, mridangam, violin, and mandolin.
 
• U Srinivas's adaptation of the mandolin to Carnatic music has inspired many young musicians to take up the instrument.
 
 
 
• **Padma Shri:**
 
 
• Padma Shri is the fourth highest civilian award in the Republic of India.
 
• It is awarded to citizens of India in recognition of their distinguished contribution in various spheres including arts, education, industry, literature, science, sports, medicine, social service, and public affairs.
 
• U Srinivas was awarded the Padma Shri in 1998 for his contributions to Indian classical music.
 
 
 
• **Sangeet Natak Akademi Award:**
 
 
• The Sangeet Natak Akademi Award is an award given by the Sangeet Natak Akademi, India's National Academy of Music, Dance & Drama.
 
• It is the highest Indian recognition given to practicing artists.
 
• U Srinivas received the Sangeet Natak Akademi Award in 2010 for his exceptional contribution to Carnatic music.
